title: The appliance runs on the own kernel
notes: (v31) and `recovery` holds a real stock-kernel rescue, round trip measured.
result: `taq102-display` loads the PHY module from `/init`; `taq102-app` waits for `/dev/dri/card0`; cube at 5.10 s from power-on. v18 had been our own kernel without the PHY, a blind rescue. `flash-recovery.sh` verifies by readback before writing the BCB. The volume button does not boot `recovery`; it trips the autostart hatch (`KEY_BACK`).
